policy.purpose: Track major OSS donors/runtimes independently from package-lock dependency inventory.
policy.importRule: ANALYZE -> DECOMPOSE -> REUSE -> ADAPT -> REPURPOSE -> COMBINE -> GENERALIZE -> INNOVATE -> WRAP -> BUILD LAST -> REJECT ONLY WITH EVIDENCE; imports still require exact license/path/pin verification, tests and hardening
policy.evidenceRule: SI phases are strategic; S0-S10 are validation journeys and CP records are historical evidence. Bundled/classification/roles record package accounting or intended use, not complete subsystem or Shipping Point acceptance. SP-01-SP-07 require real MSJs, applicable target execution, no fake success, regression protection and exact build/target/journey/checks/limitations evidence.
policy.legacyRejectionReview: A retained reject classification based only on historical domain, initial scope or overlap is a historical decision under review, not a completed SI REJECT_WITH_EVIDENCE disposition. Review mechanisms, repurposing, combination and challenger roles behind singular GM/TC/CA/P owners; licensing/branding restrictions and no brokerage writes remain unchanged.
policy.zeroSetupTarget: LiOS must provision/verify internal components without ordinary-user donor-runtime/Python/server/renderer setup; heavy optional assets require visible size/rights/consent. External Ollama, optional missing browser runtime and unintegrated engine/output/renderer candidates remain delivery gaps, not final manual-install policy.
policy.truthLadder: contract locked -> code integrated -> tests passed -> packaged/provisioned -> user accessible -> vertical flagship passed -> shipping point accepted -> release proven
policy.copyleftCorePolicy: Strong-copyleft source is not vendored into proprietary LiOS core without an explicit distribution/licensing decision.
